78393-the-cat-who-went-to-heaven.title: The Cat Who Went To Heaven
78393-the-cat-who-went-to-heaven.creator: Unknown
78393-the-cat-who-went-to-heaven.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Once upon a time, far away in Japan, a poor young artist sat alone in his little house, waiting for his dinner. His housekeeper had gone to market, and he sat sighing to think of all the things he wished she would bring home. He expected her to hurry in at any minute, bowing and opening her little basket to show him how wisely she had spent their few pennies. He heard her steps, and jumped up.

arxiv-1801-06407.title: Size vs. structure in training corpora for word embedding models: Araneum Russicum Maximum and Russian National Corpus
arxiv-1801-06407.creator: Andrey Kutuzov, Maria Kunilovskaya
arxiv-1801-06407.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a distributional word embedding model trained on one of the largest available Russian corpora: Araneum Russicum Maximum (over 10 billion words crawled from the web). We compare this model to the model trained on the Russian National Corpus (RNC). The two corpora are much different in their size and compilation procedures.

arxiv-1908-08294.title: Robustly segmenting quadriceps muscles of ultra-endurance athletes with weakly supervised U-Net
arxiv-1908-08294.creator: Hoai-Thu Nguyen 1, Pierre Croisille 1,2, Magalie Viallon 1,2, Sarah Leclerc 3, Sylvain Grange 1,2, Rémi Grange 2, Olivier Bernard 3, Thomas Grenier 3
arxiv-1908-08294.description: Abstract In this study, segmentation of quadriceps muscle heads of ultra-endurance athletes was done using a multi-atlas segmentation and corrective leaning framework where the registration based multi-atlas segmentation step was replaced with weakly supervised U-Net. For the case with remarkably different morphology, our method produced improved accuracy, while reduced significantly the computation time.

arxiv-2011-02045.title: Face Morphing Attack Generation & Detection: A Comprehensive Survey
arxiv-2011-02045.creator: Sushma Venkatesh, Raghavendra Ramachandra, Kiran Raja, Christoph Busch
arxiv-2011-02045.description: Abstract Face recognition has been successfully deployed in real-time applications including secure applications like border control. The vulnerability of Face Recognition System (FRS) to various kind of attacks (both direct and in-direct attacks) and face morphing attacks has received a great interest from the biometric community.

arxiv-2011-06948.description: Abstract In this article, we study in a little more detail the angular kinetic–energy distribution of halo Weakly Interacting Massive Particles (WIMPs) and consider two simple modifications with the Solar Galactic orbital velocity in our Monte Carlo simulations of the 3-dimensional WIMP velocity as the first trial of future investigations on distinguishing models of the Galactic structure of Dark Matter

arxiv-2102-11057.title: Hierarchical Graph Representations in Digital Pathology
arxiv-2102-11057.creator: Pushpak Pati* 1,2, Guillaume Jaume* 1,3, Antonio Foncubierta-Rodríguez 1, Florinda Feroce 4, Anna Maria Anniciello 4, Giosue Scognamiglio 4, Nadia Brancati 5, Maryse Fiche 6, Estelle Dubruc 7, Daniel Riccio 5, Maurizio Di Bonito 4, Giuseppe De Pietro 5, Gerardo Botti 4, Jean-Philippe Thiran 3, Maria
arxiv-2102-11057.description: Abstract Cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and therapy response predictions from tissue specimens highly depend on the phenotype and topological distribution of constituting histological entities. Thus, adequate tissue representations for encoding histological entities is imperative for computer aided cancer patient care. To this end, several approaches have leveraged cell-graphs that encode cell morphology and cell organization to denote the tissue information.

arxiv-2309-08447.title: A theory of phonon-induced friction on molecular adsorbates
arxiv-2309-08447.creator: Ardavan Farahvash, Adam P. Willard
arxiv-2309-08447.description: Abstract In this manuscript, we provide a general theory for how surface phonons couple to molecular adsorbates. Our theory maps the extended dynamics of a surface’s atomic vibrational motions to a generalized Langevin equation, and by doing so captures these dynamics in a single quantity: the non-Markovian friction.

arxiv-2409-18221.title: Statistical analysis on the effectiveness of a low insulin index, alkaline and functional diet evaluated with machine learning techniques
arxiv-2409-18221.creator: F. A. Conventi, F. Cirotto, A. D’Avanzo, Ag. De Iorio, E. Rossi, An. De Iorio, M. Forte, F. Miele, G. Perna, B. Rossi, F. Antoniali, M. L. Conza, N. Formicola
arxiv-2409-18221.description: Abstract In this paper, a statistical analysis of the performance of a low insulin index, alkaline and functional diet developed by ANTUR evaluated with machine learning techniques is reported. The sample of patients was checked on a regular basis with a BioImpedenziometric (BIA) analysis. The BIA gives about 40 parameters output describing the health status of the patient.

arxiv-2412-17916.title: Data-Driven Priors in the Maximum Entropy on the Mean Method for Linear Inverse Problems.
arxiv-2412-17916.creator: Matthew King-Roskamp, Rustum Choksi, Tim Hoheisel
arxiv-2412-17916.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Matthew King-Roskamp, Rustum Choksi, Tim Hoheisel. We establish the theoretical framework for implementing the maximumn entropy on the mean (MEM) method for linear inverse problems in the setting of approximate (data-driven) priors. convergence for empirical means and further develop general estimates for the difference between the MEM solutions with different priors μ \mu and ν \nu based upon the epigraphical distance between their respective log-moment generating functions. These estimates allow us to establish a rate of convergence in expectation for empirical means.

arxiv-2510-10024.title: The eigentheory for nonlocal cooperative-advective system and its role in the study of free boundary system for directional epidemic models
arxiv-2510-10024.creator: Soufiane Bentout, Hoang-Hung Vo
arxiv-2510-10024.description: Abstract . In this paper, in the absence of a variational structure but under sharper regularity requirements on the solutions, we propose and analyze a nonlocal cooperative reaction–diffusion system with free boundaries and drift terms, motivated by the models of directional epidemic spread.

pmc-10569641.title: Knowledge graph empowerment from knowledge learning to graduation requirements achievement
pmc-10569641.creator: Yangrui Yang, Sisi Chen, Yaping Zhu, Hao Zhu, Zhigang Chen, Sathishkumar Veerappampalayam Easwaramoorthy, Sathishkumar Veerappampalayam Easwaramoorthy, Sathishkumar Veerappampalayam Easwaramoorthy
pmc-10569641.description: A deep understanding of the relationship between the knowledge acquired and the graduation requirements is essential for students to precisely meet the graduation requirements and to become human resources with specific knowledge, skills and professionalism. In this paper, we define the ontology layer of the knowledge graph by deeply analyzing the relationship between graduation requirement, course and knowledge.

pmc-10747830.title: Biocompatibility of ABS and PLA Polymers with Dental Pulp Stem Cells Enhance Their Potential Biomedical Applications
pmc-10747830.creator: Fabiane Barchiki, Letícia Fracaro, Alejandro Correa Dominguez, Alexandra Cristina Senegaglia, Isadora May Vaz, Paulo Soares, Sérgio Adriane Bezerra de Moura, Paulo Roberto Slud Brofman
pmc-10747830.description: Polylactic Acid (PLA) and Acrylonitrile–Butadiene–Styrene (ABS) are commonly used polymers in 3D printing for biomedical applications. Dental Pulp Stem Cells (DPSCs) are an accessible and proliferative source of stem cells with significant differentiation potential. Limited knowledge exists regarding the biocompatibility and genetic safety of ABS and PLA when in contact with DPSCs.

pmc-11489289.title: Risk factors for postoperative complications in patients undergoing cytoreductive surgery combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy: A meta-analysis and systematic review
pmc-11489289.creator: Dengzhuo Chen, Yongli Ma, Jinghui Li, Liang Wen, Guosheng Zhang, Chengzhi Huang, Xueqing Yao
pmc-11489289.description: ObjectiveCytoreductive surgery (CRS) combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) is one of the most effective treatments for intraperitoneal malignancies. However, current research on risk factors for postoperative complications needs to be more consistent. This study aimed to conduct a meta-analysis of the risk factors for postoperative complications in CRS + HIPEC patients.

pmc-11716121.title: Large‐scale Proteomic Analyses of Incident Alzheimer's Disease Reveal New Pathophysiological Insights and Biomarkers
pmc-11716121.creator: Yi Zhang, Yu Guo, JIA YOU, Yu He, Jin‐Tai Yu
pmc-11716121.description: BackgroundThe pathophysiological evolutions involved in early‐stage Alzheimer’s disease (AD) are not well understood.MethodsWe used data of 2,923 plasma proteins from 51,296 non‐demented middle‐aged adults in the UK Biobank with 15 years of follow‐up. We first identified AD‐associated proteins using Cox proportional hazard models and then delineated their temporal sequences to characterize the pathophysiological evolution.

pmc-13074342.title: Titanium Dioxide in Biomedical and Environmental Nanotechnology: From Photocatalytic Detoxification to Targeted Therapeutics
pmc-13074342.creator: Avraham Dayan, Gideon Fleminger
pmc-13074342.description: Titanium dioxide (TiO2) has evolved from a conventional photocatalyst into a sophisticated nano-platform that bridges environmental sustainability and biomedicine. This paper proposes a unified interfacial redox design framework that links the electronic-structure engineering of the TiO2 with the spatial control of its reactive oxygen species (ROS).

pmc-13077431.title: Lung squamous cell carcinoma downregulates haptoglobin expression to inhibit M2 macrophage ferroptosis via the hemoglobin-dependent CD163/HO-1 pathway
pmc-13077431.creator: Weijing Xie, Ying-Ying Lin, Guang-Hong Tan, Feng-Ying Huang
pmc-13077431.description: Lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) is a highly malignant tumor that poses significant challenges for targeted therapy. Thus, there is a need to identify novel treatment targets. Acute-phase proteins (APPs) have been implicated in various physiological and pathophysiological processes, including cancer progression and ferroptosis. However, it remains unclear whether APPs serve a role in the progression and ferroptosis of LUSC.

pmc-13289362.title: Joint progression and determinants of hypertension and type 2 diabetes among adults in post-conflict Tigray, Ethiopia: implications for chronic disease care in fragile health systems
pmc-13289362.creator: Abdukadir Nigus Mohammed, Edris Abdu Debesay, Ashagire Zenebe Woldearegawi

pmc-13297822.title: Facile and Green Fabrication of Porous Hydrogels Based on Gelatin Microsphere Porogens for 3D Immune Cell Culture
pmc-13297822.creator: Han Fu, Qiwen Yao, Shuai Tan, Yingming Wang, Aishun Jin
pmc-13297822.description: Porous hydrogels are critical for tissue engineering and regenerative medicine, as they mimic the native extracellular matrix to support cell infiltration and mass transport. A common strategy for engineering pore structures involves the incorporation and subsequent removal of sacrificial porogen templates (e.g., crystals or microspheres).

pmc-13318712.title: Resetting the epigenetic clock: cellular senescence and regenerative strategies in intervertebral disc degeneration
pmc-13318712.creator: Minfan Li, Haitao Deng, Hongda Xu, Qingzhong Zhou, Shengxin Zhao

pmc-13338453.title: Immunomodulatory Potential of Quinoline Q3, a Selective Inhibitor of the Canonical NF‐κB Pathway in Macrophages
pmc-13338453.creator: Konstantinos Michail, Panagiotis Ntavaroukas, Vasiliki Petriki, Evangelos Tsioupros, Stella Manta, Barry J Campbell, Stamatia Papoutsopoulou
pmc-13338453.description: The NF‐κB transcription factor pathway is a major driver of inflammation, regulating proinflammatory cytokine synthesis in innate immune cells. Its dysregulation is linked to chronic inflammatory diseases, as well as autoimmune conditions. We investigated the inhibitory effect of a novel quinoline Q3 on NF‐κB activation in murine and human macrophages. Without little/no effect on cell survival or proliferation of J774A.

pmc-13492337.title: Development and validation of an artificial intelligence-based tool to detect subclinical atheroesclerosis using non-mydriatic retinal funduscopic images: the Aitheroscope project
pmc-13492337.creator: Juan Torres-Macho, María Ángeles Sánchez-Uriz, Vyara Hrystova, Jesús Prada-Alonso, Jose Manuel López-Aragonés, Nuria Muñoz-Rivas, Anabel Franco-Moreno, Eva Moya-Mateo, María Pilar Ferrera-Ahijado, Eva María Duro-Perales, María Antón-Vallejo, Montserrat Saiz-González, Alberto Diez-García, Celeste Mar
pmc-13492337.description: AimsCurrent cardiovascular risk scores may underestimate the risk of future cardiovascular events, particularly in younger individuals with prolonged exposure to risk factors. In contrast, imaging-based detection of subclinical atherosclerosis provides a more accurate assessment of cardiovascular risk by identifying established vascular disease.

pmc-13568388.title: Comparative Evaluation of Cross-Sectional Geometric Feature Extraction Algorithms for LiDAR-Based Inclination Detection of Lattice Steel Towers
pmc-13568388.creator: Mingduan Zhou, Guanxiu Wu, Lu Qin, Shufa Li
pmc-13568388.description: Highlights What are the main findings? A unified evaluation framework integrating cross-sectional slicing, feature extraction, and axis reconstruction was proposed for LiDAR-based inclination detection of lattice steel towers. The framework enables a comparative evaluation of the performance of the RANSAC and Marching Square algorithms for cross-sectional geometric feature extraction under open-frame structural conditions.

pmc-13599775.title: Depression trends in Europe: sociodemographic differences
pmc-13599775.creator: Johannes Beller, Julia Graßhoff, Stefanie Sperlich, Siegfried Geyer

pmc-13621733.title: MLKL confers ferroptosis resistance in colorectal cancer cells via impaired ESCRT-III-mediated membrane repair
pmc-13621733.creator: Sasiprapa Sonkaew, Nattaya Duangthim, Chutikarn Butkinaree, Yodying Yingchutrakul, Swati Choksi, Zheng-Gang Liu, Siriporn Jitkaew
pmc-13621733.description: BackgroundFerroptosis resistance is a major challenge in cancer therapy, contributing to poor prognosis and unsatisfactory treatment outcomes. Thus, identifying key regulators of ferroptosis is essential for developing strategies to overcome this limitation. Mixed lineage kinase domain-like protein (MLKL) is well established as the executioner of necroptosis, but emerging evidence suggests broader functions beyond necroptosis.

pmc-4987875.title: W-IQ-TREE: a fast online phylogenetic tool for maximum likelihood analysis
pmc-4987875.creator: Jana Trifinopoulos, Lam-Tung Nguyen, Arndt von Haeseler et al.
pmc-4987875.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). This article presents W-IQ-TREE, an intuitive and user-friendly web interface and server for IQ-TREE, an efficient phylogenetic software for maximum likelihood analysis.
